workflow.title: Workflows
workflow.empty: No workflows yet. Add one to run automation when a trigger fires.
workflow.activity.empty: No activities yet — add at least one for the workflow to do anything.
workflow.activity.unknownKind.noEditor: This activity has no editor — it will be sent to the server as-is.
workflow.activity.incompatible: Incompatible: the item type reaching this step isn't accepted. Add a transform before it.
workflow.activity.skipOnItemError: Skip items that fail (instead of aborting the run)
workflow.field.name: Name
workflow.create.title: Add workflow
workflow.edit.title: Edit workflow
workflow.trigger.subscriptionUpdated.sub: Pick specific subscriptions. Leave empty to match all (subject to the kinds filter below).
workflow.trigger.subscriptionUpdated.kin: Pick subscription kinds. Leave empty to match all (subject to the subscriptions filter above).
workflow.activity.subscriptionItemTitleC: One per line (or comma-separated). Case-insensitive. Item matches if ANY keyword appears in its title.
workflow.runs.title: Run history
workflow.activity.exhentaiQueryToGallery: No options — searches ExHentai and takes the first gallery.
workflow.activity.aiTransform.targetItem: Pick the type this transform should produce. Leave on "auto-detect" to inherit the next activity's required type.
workflow.activity.aiTransform.extraInstr: Appended to the LLM's system prompt. Use this to describe the source's meaning or constrain the output beyond the schema.
workflow.activity.aiTransform.summary.ta: auto-detect target type from next step
workflow.activity.picker.title: Add activity
workflow.activity.picker.searchPlacehold: Filter by name, kind, or group…
workflow.activity.picker.empty: No activities accept the item type at this position.
workflow.activity.picker.needsBridge.des: Adding this will also insert an AI transform node right before it, configured to produce the type this activity needs.
workflow.trigger.downloaderCompleted.thi: Only fire when the completed task belongs to one of the picked sources. Leave empty to match every source.
workflow.activity.createNotification.tit: Required. Use {{fieldName}} to interpolate item fields (e.g. "Downloaded {{name}}").
workflow.activity.createNotification.sum: Empty title — configure one to enable saving.
workflow.manualRun.title: Run "{{name}}" now
workflow.manualRun.hint: This trigger fires on an event, so a manual run needs a payload to stand in for one. It runs regardless of the trigger filter and the enabled switch.
workflow.trigger.fsManualScan.roots.empt: Pick at least one directory — this workflow has nothing to scan yet.
workflow.trigger.fsManualScan.extensions: Comma-separated, e.g. mkv, mp4. Empty = all files.
The extension filter only applies to files and is ignored while emitting directories only.
workflow.activity.fsFileNameOp.summary.e: No operations configured — this step changes nothing.
workflow.activity.fsSaveName.hint: Records every changed name into the run's rename plan. Preview only — the disk is not touched.
workflow.renamePlan.title: Rename plan · run #{{runId}}
workflow.renamePlan.apply.confirmContent: The files and directories will actually be renamed. Every rename is recorded and can be undone from this panel.
workflow.renamePlan.apply.partial: Applied {{applied}}, {{failed}} failed — see the rows marked Failed for reasons.
workflow.renamePlan.undo.confirmContent: Every applied rename is reverted to its original name where the disk still allows it.
workflow.renamePlan.undo.partial: Undid {{undone}}, {{blocked}} blocked — see the rows still marked Applied for reasons.
workflow.activity.textRemoveWrapped.wrap: A delimiter-pair text type — e.g. [ ] or ( ). Only pair-shaped types are offered.
Wrapped content matching this set's entries is removed together with its wrappers.
workflow.activity.textRemoveWrapped.summ: Pick a wrappers type and a text set to enable this step.
workflow.activity.textRemoveTexts.set.de: Bare occurrences of this set's entries are removed from the text.
workflow.activity.textRemoveTexts.summar: Pick a text set to enable this step.
workflow.activity.textTrim.trimEnds.labe: Trim whitespace and separators from both ends
workflow.activity.textTrim.summary.noop: All switches off — this step changes nothing.
workflow.activity.textOps.mode.label: Match mode
workflow.activity.textCapture.pattern.de: Regex with named groups, e.g. S(?<season>\d+)E(?<ep>\d+). Each matched group becomes a variable riding with the item.
workflow.activity.textCapture.groups.non: no named groups yet — add (?<name>…) to capture something
workflow.activity.textCapture.summary.un: Configure a pattern to enable this step.
workflow.activity.textCapture.summary.no: pattern has no named groups — captures nothing
Rebuilds the working text. {var:name} inserts a variable, {var:name:pad(2)} zero-pads it, {originalText} is the incoming text.
workflow.activity.textTemplate.lint.unkn: Unknown variables: {{vars}} — no upstream capture or system variable provides them; they will render empty.
workflow.activity.textTemplate.requiredV: Comma-separated. An item missing any of these fails instead of rendering an empty value.
workflow.activity.textTemplate.summary.u: Configure a template to enable this step.
workflow.activity.fsExpandChildren.inclu: Keep the directory itself in the chain too
